title: Sentence stress and rhythm
what: stressing every word evenly instead of the content words, so speech sounds flat and hard to follow
summary: Even stress often persists because it's a rhythmic rather than a lexical error, making it difficult to self-correct. This flatness can make speech sound unnatural and less engaging, potentially obscuring the speaker's intended emphasis.
listenFor: Pay attention to whether every word in your sentences receives similar emphasis, rather than allowing key content words to stand out.
drills: The project manager meticulously reviewed the comprehensive financial report.
Effective communication is crucial for successful international business negotiations.
We must carefully consider all potential risks before making a final investment.
Developing innovative solutions requires creative thinking and persistent effort.
The economic forecast suggests a gradual recovery in the coming months.
She frequently travels for work, attending conferences and client meetings.
Understanding complex data analytics is essential for strategic decision-making.
The new policy significantly impacts employee benefits and compensation structures.
They successfully implemented a robust system to streamline operational processes.
Our primary objective is to enhance customer satisfaction and market share.
